arabic_text: فَإنَّهُ لا يُوحِشُ مِنَ الدُّنْيا إلاّ خَوْفُكَ،
english_text: Certainly, nothing causes alienation from this world except fear of You,

arabic_text: وَ لا يُؤْنِسُ بِالآخِرَةِ إلاّ رَجآؤُكَ،
transliteration: wa lā yu'nisu bil ākhirati 'illā rajā'uk,
english_text: and nothing causes to be accustomed to the hereafter except hope for Your (mercy).

arabic_text: اَللّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحُجَّةُ لا عَلَيْكَ،
english_text: O Allah! For You is the argument, not against You,

arabic_text: وَ إلَيْكَ الْمُشْتَكى لا مِنْكَ،
english_text: and to You is complained, not from You.

arabic_text: فَصَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
english_text: Thus, bless Muhammad and his family,

arabic_text: وَ أعِنّي عَلى نَفْسِيَ الظّالِمَةِ الْعاصِيَةِ،
english_text: and assist me against my unjust and disobedient soul,

arabic_text: وَ شَهْوَتِيَ الْغالِبَةِ،
english_text: and my dominant desire.

arabic_text: وَاخْتِمْ لي بِالْعافِيَةِ،
english_text: And conclude me with a safe and healthy end.

arabic_text: اَللّهُمَّ إنَّ اسْتِغْفاري إيّاكَ وَ أنَا مُصِرٌّ عَلى مانَهَيْتَ قِلَّةُ حَيآء،
transliteration: allāhumma 'innastighfārī 'iyyāka wa 'ana muširrun alā mā nahayta qillatu ħayā',
english_text: O Allah! It is due to my shamelessness that I ask forgiveness while I insist on what You have forbidden.

arabic_text: وَ تَرْكِيَ الاِسْتِغْفارَ مَعَ عِلْمي بِسِعَةِ حِلْمِكَ تَضْييعٌ لِحَقِّ الرَّجآءِ،
transliteration: wa tarkiyal 'istighfāra maa ilmī bisiati ħilmika tađhyī'un liħaqqir-rajā'
english_text: On the other hand, if I do not ask for forgiveness with my knowledge of Your abundant forbearance, it will be wasting the right of hope (to You).

arabic_text: اَللّهُمَّ إنَّ ذُنُوبي تُؤْيِسُني أنْ أرْجُوَكَ،
english_text: My Allah! (due to my weak faith) my sins discourage me from requesting You,

arabic_text: وَ إنَّ عِلْمي بِسِعَةِ رَحْمَتِكَ يَمْنَعُني أنْ أخْشاكَ،
transliteration: wa inna ilmi bisiati rahmatika yamnaunī 'an 'akhshāk,
english_text: and my knowledge about Your vast mercy prevents me from fearing You.

arabic_text: فَصَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ،
transliteration: fašalli alā muħammadin wa āli muħammad,
english_text: Thus, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,

arabic_text: وَ صَدِّقْ رَجائي لَكَ،
english_text: and confirm my hope in You,

arabic_text: وَ كَذِّبْ خَوْفي مِنْكَ،
english_text: negate my fear of You,

arabic_text: وَ كُنْ لي عِنْدَ أحْسَنِ ظَنّي بِكَ يا أكْرَمَ الأكْرَمينَ،
transliteration: wa kun lī inda 'aħsani đanni bika yā 'akramal 'akramīn
english_text: and be for me according to the best of what I expect and believe about You, O the most generous of the generous!

arabic_text: اَللّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أيِّدْني بِالْعِصْمَةِ،
transliteration: allāhumma šalli alā muħammadin wa āli muħammadin, wa 'ayyidnī bil išmah,
english_text: O Allah! Bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, and support me by protection (from sins),

arabic_text: وَ أنْطِقْ لِساني بِالْحِكْمَةِ،
english_text: Make my tongue speak wisdom,

arabic_text: وَ اجْعَلْني مِمَّنْ يَنْدَمُ عَلى ما ضَيَّعَهُ في أمْسِهِ،
transliteration: wajalnī mimman yandamu alā mā đhayyaahu fī 'amsih,
english_text: Place me among those who regret what they wasted yesterday,

arabic_text: وَ لا يَغْبَنُ حَظَّهُ في يَوْمِهِ،
transliteration: wa lā yaghbanu ħađđahu fī yawmih,
english_text: do not aggrieve their portion today,

arabic_text: وَ لا يَهُمُّ لِرِزْقِ غَدِهِ،
english_text: and do not worry about the sustenance of tomorrow.

arabic_text: اَللّهُمَّ إنَّ الْغَنِيَّ مَنِ اسْتَغْنى بِكَ وَ افْتَقَرَ إلَيْكَ،
english_text: O Allah! Certainly, rich is he who suffices himself with You and considers himself in need of You,

arabic_text: وَ الْفَقيرَ مَنِ اسْتَغْنى بِخَلْقِكَ عَنْكَ،
english_text: and poor is he who feels that he can suffice himself through Your creation without You.

arabic_text: فَصَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ،
transliteration: fašalli alā muħammadin wa āli muħammad,
english_text: Thus, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,

arabic_text: وَ أغْنِني عَنْ خَلْقِكَ بِكَ،
english_text: and suffice me from Your creation by Yourself,

arabic_text: وَ اجْعَلْني مِمَّنْ لا يَبْسُطُ كَفّاً إلاّ إلَيْكَ،
english_text: and put me amongst those who do not extend their hand except towards You.

arabic_text: اَللّهُمَّ إنَّ الشَّقِيَّ مَنْ قَنَطَ وَ أمامَهُ التَّوْبَةُ وَ وَرآءَهُ الرَّحْمَةُ،
transliteration: allāhumma 'innash-shaqiyya man qanaţa wa 'amāmahut-tawbatu wa warā'ahur-rahmah,
english_text: My Allah! Certainly, wretched is he who despairs while repentance is placed before him and mercy is after him,

arabic_text: وَ إنْ كُنْتُ ضَعيفَ الْعَمَلِ فَإ نّي في رَحْمَتِكَ قَوِيُّ الأمَلِ،
transliteration: wa 'in kuntu đhaīfal amali fa 'innī fī raħmatika qawiyyal 'amal,
english_text: Even though I have been weak in action, I have strong hope in Your mercy,

arabic_text: فَهَبْ لي ضَعْفَ عَمَلي لِقُوَّةِ أمَلي،
english_text: Thus, forgive the weakness of my action in light of the strength of my hope.

arabic_text: اَللّهُمَّ إنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أنْ ما في عِبادِكَ مَنْ هُوَ أقْسى قَلْباً مِنّي وَ أعْظَمُ مِنّي ذَنْباً،
transliteration: allāhumma 'in kunta talamu 'an mā fī 'ibādika man huwa 'aqsā qalban minnī wa 'ađamu minnī dhanbā,
english_text: O Allah! Even if You know there is no one amongst Your servants with harder heart and greater sins than mine,
